title: Mixed Event — Smile of a Dreamer — Episode5 Please Talk to Me

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime picks up the pace in preparation for their final Show Contest performance! At the same time, Emu learns that her brothers are working on a huge overhaul of Phoenix Wonderland. She tries to convince them to reconsider, but will she be successful?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're late. How did it take you this long to get to the gate? Your legs really are useless.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-Hey, it's not my fault! The teacher asked me to help out with something! Also, my legs are not useless!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why are you asking? You already know the answer.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. That's why you've been so prickly today. I apologize for making you wait like that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't turn all humble on me like that. It feels weird...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How about you show some modesty for a change?! Also, do you have to take jabs at me every time we talk?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I just don't know what we can do...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That is the issue. Especially as long as Emu doesn't tell us what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But forcing it out of her would be difficult as well, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She usually just says whatever's on her mind...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, it may seem like she is, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because we were all so busy preparing the show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Grandpa told me that you need a diverse troupe for a good show, and at least one of them has to be committed to helping all the others' talents shine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The bigger the problem, the less likely she is to talk...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This may be a case of just that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So it's likely that she won't tell us anytime soon.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose we should try to come up with some better ideas in the meantime...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
Sorry for being late!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm all ready to go☆
Let's head over to SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, I wanna get to know you better!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You were a member of a theater troupe before, right? What kinds of shows did you guys do? Which ones did you like? And...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Slow down! Don't ask me so many questions at once or I won't know where to start...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Why don't we take a break now?
That way you'll have time to chat.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You might even enjoy opening up a bit and sharing your memories with a friend.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Fine, but only until the break's over.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Talking to Emu that time helped me figure some things out, so I should return that favor.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She pries into everyone else's business, but clams up when it comes to her own...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (At the same time, if it really is something big, she might not be able to tell us easily...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, I'd want to know even more if that's the case...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If something's bothering her, I want to be there for her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I don't really know how to tell her that...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I will deliver this message to Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No... Stop!! Where are you going?!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I will deliver this message to Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What message?! Did Rui install something that lets you do that?! You don't need to do anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh... Time to go after it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I want everyone to be able to focus on being able to perform the shows they love so much...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Is that Robo-Nene coming this way...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you in such a hurry, Robo-Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene's Voice
rows.Line: <If something's bothering her, I want to be there for her.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I get that something might be keeping you from telling us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But when you feel like talking, please tell us everything...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Nene and the others will listen. They might help me come up with some ideas...)
